description: Verify a CFDI with SAT. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "cfdi/endpoints/cfdi-verify".

retention.description: true when the folio is a CFDI de retenciones, which SAT checks apart from invoices. Not needed with `xml`: a retention's XML is recognized.

uuid.description: Folio fiscal (UUID) of the CFDI, any case.

xml.description: The CFDI XML document as a string, as stamped by the PAC (with its tfd:TimbreFiscalDigital).

name: cfdi_verify
title: Verify a CFDI with SAT
